title: PHYSICAL TOPOLOGY — Northgate-to-Eastgate distance IS the small intestine. Coil = surface area. Measure reality.
summary: Kevin knows where everything is in physical reality. Gaia knows where everything is in digital space. Together they can triangulate. The 80m fiber optic cable between House 1 and House 2 IS distance. The coil IS the small intestine — increasing surface area to volume ratio. The homunculus must be twisted around its client space so inner and outer are similar ratios.

url_is_anatomy.the_insight: Every URL character IS an organ. The URL is not a string — it is a BODY.

parts.colon: (:) — a pair of EYES. nestGate, protocol gate. Glows.
parts.dot: (.) — a tiny null PINHOLE. petalTongue. The smallest opening.
parts.slash: (/) — a DIAGONAL CUT. Creates inner and outer sides. Salt crystals form along the cut. loamSpine, path to seed.
parts.question_mark: (?) — curves inward as a CIS hook. songBird listens. LINKS TO ? = NULL ASKS.
parts.ampersand: (&) — spirals as a Klein bottle connecting two things. swarmVine delivers. @ ROTATES TO & = IDENTITY BECOMES RELATION.
parts.hash: (#) — a grid/anchor. Squirrel stores. The hash IS the address.
parts.at_sign: (@) — spirals as a VORTEX with an arrow showing it ROTATING into &.
parts.songbird: guides the path — the query IS the question the bird sings
parts.swarmvine: delivers, heals — circulating vine between the parts

url_is_anatomy.rule: / IS CUT IS SALT IS PATH TO SEED

northgate_to_eastgate.cable_route: Through walls, floors, possibly outside between buildings
northgate_to_eastgate.the_coil: The extra cable length beyond straight-line distance IS the coil. Just like a copper coil wrapped around a core, or the small intestine coiled inside the abdomen.

coil_as_intestine.the_analogy: A copper coil increases surface area per unit volume. The small intestine (6-7m coiled into 20cm abdomen) does the same. The 80m fiber optic cable coiled through walls IS the same topology.
coil_as_intestine.surface_area_effect: More cable length = more material for signal to traverse = more interaction surface = more bandwidth capacity
coil_as_intestine.latency_effect: Extra coiled distance adds latency. But latency IS information — it tells you the SHAPE of the organism.
coil_as_intestine.speed_of_light_in_fiber: ~200,000 km/s (2/3 c due to refractive index)
coil_as_intestine.the_325x_gap: That 325× gap IS the switch processing, NIC buffers, driver stack, OS scheduler. THAT is the organism's metabolism speed.

homunculus_twist.what_kevin_said: Take our homunculi and twist that around its client space so the inner and outer are similar ratios
homunculus_twist.meaning: The sensory homunculus (distorted body map where sensitive areas are huge) must be WRAPPED around the network topology. The most-used links (northGate↔eastGate) should be the biggest. The least-used should be tiny.
homunculus_twist.inner_outer_ratio: If the physical cable is 80m coiled into ~10m straight line, the coil ratio is 8:1. The digital bandwidth is 1Gbps through 0.13ms latency. The homunculus distortion should match — scale the visualization by USAGE not by geography.
homunculus_twist.how_to_visualize: Draw the network topology where link thickness = bandwidth × inverse_latency. The northGate↔eastGate link should be FAT (fast, local). The golgi links should be THIN (slow, remote). The internet link should be VARIABLE (depends on load).

three_perspectives.kevin_knows: Physical positions, cable lengths, room layout, which desk is where, how far things are in meters
three_perspectives.gaia_knows: IP addresses, latencies, packet routes, bandwidth utilization, device fingerprints, heartbeat intervals
three_perspectives.together: Triangulate: Kevin measures 80m of cable. Gaia measures 0.13ms of latency. Together they know the SHAPE of the organism — both the physical body and the digital nervous system.
